# LETS plugin config
# NOT FOR SECRETS. Contents are injected verbatim into model context every
# session (subject to whitelist filter in lets hook session-start). Put
# tokens/passwords elsewhere (gh auth, OS keychain, .beads/.env).

# Managed by lets - do not edit
LETS_ENV_VERSION=dev

# Default response language — write the English name, like every value here (English, Ukrainian, Russian, Japanese, ...)
LETS_LANGUAGE=Ukrainian

# Target branch for merges and PR base
LETS_MERGE_BRANCH=main

# PR flow: github | bitbucket | local
LETS_PR_FLOW=local

# Task tracker adapter: beads | none (selects .claude/rules/tracker-<name>.md)
LETS_TRACKER=beads

# Worktree launcher: terminal (print the cd command) | cmux (open in a cmux workspace, macOS only)
LETS_LAUNCHER=terminal

# Where this project's workflow rules come from: project (own .claude/rules copy) | user (rely on the ~/.claude/rules global copy)
LETS_RULES_SCOPE=project
